ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 75% high-intensity (white) and 25% low-intensity (black/grey) pixel distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity cluster at the median notch radiating into multiple thin, high-contrast linear streaks toward the distal tips. Small, isolated low-intensity blobs are scattered along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, jagged edge topography with pixel-amplitude variations forming a series of peaks and valleys across the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curve on the leading edge tapering to sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) radiating laterally from the central notch area across both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notches and jagged disruptions along the trailing edge topography, particularly on the medial section of the right lobe.
